C-SELECTION.Summary: Task slices and skill subsetting (D15): emit the minimal relevant set of artifacts and of skills deterministically from graph and cursor state, never by model paraphrase, and report selectionRatio against a pinned full envelope so the savings claim has a number.
C-SELECTION.Problem:
D15 and D7 restore v3's ExecutionPacket field list as a *projection*, not an authored document: purpose text, graph-minimal module and verification excerpts, write scope, and absolute exclusions — composed over retrieval primitives that already exist (module show --with verification, module find --depends-on, file show --contracts). Nothing at 7e2eadb performs that composition. Agents still load whole plans, whole graphs, and all 16 skills by habit.
Three measurement holes block an honest ship of that composition. First, .ngrace/changes/active/ holds only .gitkeep — zero active tasks — while §8.5.7 demands ≥3 real tasks from this repository's own .ngrace, and §8.5.2's "archived bundles never appear" does not say whether an archived task may be a *subject* (A47.2 corr 117). Second, selectionRatio(full, selected) exists in test-support (token-accounting.ts:143) and nothing defines full or the unit (corr 118–119). Third, "byte-identical" Purpose text is untestable against indented multi-line XML without a normalization rule (corr 120).
The plan's §8.4 cites "§4.1" and "§4.6 rule 2" which resolve to Phase 4's objective and done criteria; the real slice field list and design-context exclusion live in review-consolidated.md at :284 and :493 (corr 115). Tasks have Title not Summary (grammar.ts:48); Satisfies→AC-* resolution is real (grammar.ts:1755–1774) (corr 116). Project .ngrace/context/* is neither included nor excluded by the field list (corr 122). design-context.xml is a per-bundle companion (types.ts:35), not one of those five (corr 123). Tasks do not name M-*; module set is plan DurableScope (corr 128). Stage-2 harness narrowing has no adapter in this repository (corr 125 / A46.4).

Goals.Goal: Read-only ngrace context surface: --task emits a task slice; --skills emits a skill recommendation; mutually exclusive in v1; no --compact (A47.3 decision 3 / corr 124).

Purpose header is task Title plus each Satisfies target's AC-* body from the subject spec, in Satisfies document order, after the corr 120 normalizer — wording identity, never paraphrase (corr 116, 120, 131).

Body is plan-scope graph-minimal: DurableScope GraphAnchors and VerificationAnchors, module show --with verification projections, file show --contracts when links exist, plan ObservedWriteScope files. Empty IC/LINKS are ordinary outcomes with ground, not errors (corr 127–129).

Absolute exclusions: design-context.xml never appears; archived sibling content never appears in a different subject's slice; other tasks' Title/Criterion/Verification bodies never appear; default slice omits project .ngrace/context/* and accounts for them in the full envelope (corr 122–123, 129).

Skill candidates from cursor/plan state with basis on each candidate; absent cursor yields the full published skill set; selectionStage is toolkit only until a host adapter is exercised (corr 121, 125).

selectionRatio reported in the artifact with fullBytes, selectedBytes, unit utf8-bytes, fullComposition, and subject ground — denominator fixed before measurement (A47.3 decision 2, corr 118). Separate skill ratio. No production import from test-support (corr 119).
≥3 real-repository measurements under A47.3 decision 1 (archive subjects allowed when change is explicit; live C-SELECTION tasks when plan exists). Fixtures do not answer §8.7 gate 3 (corr 132).
Both-directions controls on every inclusion and exclusion axis (corr 126, A7.2, A40.2). Standing rule 11: every emitted field reads true aloud given its sources (A46.3).

Constraints.Constraint: Selection, never compression (D15). No model in the toolkit path. No summarization of artifact text.
Compose over existing retrieval primitives; do not restore authored ExecutionPacket documents (D7). Do not invent task-level module sets from Criterion prose (corr 128, anti-pattern 3).
Read-only: context writes nothing (F1 / invariant 8). No gate.* or review.* codes from this surface. No new ledger section without a scope statement (A30.6).
package.json#files gains src/grace-context.ts when the module ships (corr 130). Skill mirrors stay byte-identical (§12.2). Invariant 7: production does not import test-support.
Stage 1 errs toward inclusion; false negatives are unrecoverable for stage 2. Correctness never depends on harness stage 2 (D15).
A47 is normative over plan §8.3–§8.5 where they differ; A48 answers A47.3 and is normative over A47 where they differ.

A48.4: §8.5.4's per-worker scope disjointness is amended, not satisfied. The artifact model has no per-task scope — ObservedWriteScope and DurableScope are plan-level (grammar.ts:40-46) — so two workers on two tasks of one plan receive the same write scope. Per-task separation is carried by the task body, DependsOn, and the exclusions. Record the amendment as absence with reasoning (rule 7 / A12.4); do not substitute a weaker test under the original heading, and do not derive a narrower scope from Criterion prose.
A48.2: design-context.xml is excluded from the denominator as well as the numerator. Counting a file that is never loaded during execution would inflate the saving for free.

A48.2: the ratio compares like with like. selectionRatio throws when selected exceeds full (token-accounting.ts:154), and a slice emits derived text — headers, labels, projections — that is not a byte-for-byte subset of the envelope. Define what counts as selected bytes so the comparison is honest, and if a subject genuinely produces selected >= full, report that result rather than narrowing the numerator until it fits.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Host-side semantic narrowing (stage 2), scoped skill loading, or any selectionStage harness success path. Document as §5.2 conditional; do not test as if present (corr 125).
Tokenizers, token caps, or aggregate skill-text ceilings (D15 rejected caps).
Authoring task-level DurableScope or per-task ObservedWriteScope. Consume plan-level scope honestly (corr 128–129).
Paying A36.4 / A46.6 graph debt (gates, review, localize modules still unlinked). Out of this phase's scope.

Fixing the ship path for src/gates and src/review (A48.5). package.json#files omits both, so the packed CLI fails at import on every invocation and validate:packed is red at HEAD; that defect is inherited from Phases 5 and 6 and earns its own C-* and its own PR, together with adding validate:packed to validate:ci. This phase still adds src/grace-context.ts to files (corr 130), and must not be read as having fixed the rest.
Embedding project principles.xml in every slice. Standing-invariants reload stays a skill instruction (corr 122).

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SELECTION-COMMAND-SHAPE: A47.3 decision 3 / corr 124. ngrace context --task and ngrace context --skills are separate outputs, mutually exclusive in v1. Discriminating negatives: passing both is invalid-arguments; neither flag invents --compact; help text says task slice / skill recommendation in the first sentence (corr 122 naming collision).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SELECTION-PURPOSE-VERBATIM: A47.2 corr 116, 120, 131. Purpose uses task Title (not Summary) and each Satisfies AC-* body after the corr 120 normalizer, in Satisfies order. Discriminating negatives: a paraphrase of Title or AC fails the wording-identity assertion; indent-only source changes do not; a multi-Satisfies task emits every AC labelled by id; an unresolvable Satisfies target is AbsenceValue for that slot, not a silent skip.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SELECTION-BODY-PLAN-SCOPE: A47.2 corr 127–129. Body module set is plan DurableScope GraphAnchors and VerificationAnchors, composed via existing module/file queries. Discriminating negatives: empty Linked Files still emit module + verification without error; a module from another plan's DurableScope does not appear; other tasks' Title strings do not appear; plan OWS files may appear for every task in the plan and are not claimed as task-private.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SELECTION-EXCLUSIONS: A47.2 corr 115, 122, 123, 126. design-context.xml never appears even when present in the subject bundle; archived sibling content never appears in a different subject's slice; project .ngrace/context/* absent from default slice; each exclusion axis has its own silent-direction control (A40.2).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SELECTION-FULL-ENVELOPE: A47.3 decision 2 / corr 118–119. Every measurement names fullBytes, selectedBytes, unit utf8-bytes, fullComposition, and selectionRatio computed as (full-selected)/full. Artifact ratio full envelope is the deterministic unselected composition A47.3 recommends; skill ratio full is the sum of published SKILL.md bytes. Discriminating negatives: a bare ratio without ground fields fails; production does not import src/test-support/.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SELECTION-REAL-MEASUREMENT: A47.3 decision 1 as answered in A48.1 / corr 117, 132. ≥3 measurements against this repository's real tasks — an archived task is a permitted subject when the caller names the change explicitly, since the exclusion governs what leaks into a slice and a subject is chosen rather than discovered. Each measurement carries subjectLocation and changeId/taskId. Discriminating negatives: a temp fixture measurement is not cited as the §8.5.7 number; an archived subject's slice states in its emitted text that the subject is archived, so a measurement artifact can never be handed to an executor as live work (rule 8, rule 11).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SELECTION-SCOPE-IS-SHARED: A48.4. The emitted write scope says it is plan-level and shared with sibling tasks. A slice that prints scope paths without that sentence is read as "these are your files", which is false for every plan with more than one task. Discriminating negatives: the sentence is present in text and JSON output; no field name or heading implies the scope is task-private; no test asserts per-task disjointness as if the model provided it.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SELECTION-READ-ONLY: F1 / invariant 8. ngrace context writes nothing under the project root. package.json#files lists src/grace-context.ts when shipped (corr 130).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SELECTION-OUTPUT-ALOUD: A46.3 standing rule 11. For each non-trivial field (Purpose Title, each AC body, each listed exclusion, each skill basis, each measurement ground field), the sentence a reader hears is true of the source artifacts. A probe that "passes" only by correcting the probe is unfinished until this table is written.
